title: Notes:
description:
renders the currently selected beatmap in song select, synced to the preview audio timestamp.

mania only (std -> mania conversion is previewed approximately; taiko/catch show a notice).

scroll speed and visuals follow the map difficulty + selected mods + player skin served by tosu.
score, combo, accuracy and judgement are intentionally not drawn.

place this counter as an OBS browser source or in the tosu ingame overlay, then size/position it freely.
value: feel free to adjust this text. it does nothing.

title: Render Scale (%)
description: scales the playfield inside the counter window

title: Auto Hide In Gameplay
description: hides the preview while playing; disable to keep it visible during play

title: Use Player Skin
description: on: use the currently selected player skin (including skin.ini mappings); key counts or elements the skin does not define fall back to the client default skin. off: always use the client default skin (osu!stable / lazer legacy assets)

title: Mania Scroll Speed Override (0 = game)
description: 1 - 40, 0 uses the scroll speed reported by tosu

title: Playfield Opacity (0 - 1)
description: opacity of notes and playfield elements

title: FPS Limit (0 = unlimited)
description: cap the redraw rate (e.g. 60) if the ingame overlay stutters
